hero.title: Renovation work I'm proud to put my name on.
hero.text: Kitchens, bathrooms, tile, flooring and stairs across Metro Vancouver. When you call, you talk to me — and I'm the one who does the work.

about.title: Hi, I'm Armen — local, hands-on, and easy to reach.
about.p1: I run EginyanConstruction myself. From the first visit to the final walkthrough, you deal with me directly — no salespeople, no hand-offs, no guessing who's showing up at your home.
about.p2: I take on a limited number of projects at a time so each one gets my full attention. I show up when I say I will, keep the work area clean, and don't call a job finished until the details are right.

facts.title: One point of contact
facts.text: You deal with me, start to finish

facts.title: English & Русский
facts.text: Happy to talk in either language

items.title: Straight answers
items.text: A clear quote up front and honest advice — even when that means a smaller job.

items.title: Attention to detail
items.text: Clean lines, level floors, tight joints. The finishing details are what you see every day.

items.title: Respect for your home
items.text: I protect the rooms I'm not working in and clean up at the end of every day.

cta.title: Planning a renovation?
cta.text: Call or email me and I'll get back to you quickly.
